Yucheng Xing邢宇程

Research Associate · Stony Brook University

I study generative models and neural dynamics, with a focus on making learning and inference more efficient and adaptive.

I received my Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from Stony Brook University in 2026, advised by Prof. Xin Wang. My work spans diffusion models, neural differential equations, and adaptive neural architectures.
